title: Enterprise Digital Platform (Multi Kreasi Printing)
description: An enterprise grade commercial B2B digital printing and procurement management platform for PT Multi Kreasi Printing with automated Job Ticket estimation, official PPN 11% invoicing, and live production tracking.

coverImage.alt: Multi Kreasi Printing Commercial B2B Platform

problem.title: The Challenge
problem.content: PT Multi Kreasi Printing required a complete modernization of their commercial print procurement operations. The legacy workflow relied on manual quotation calculations, chaotic WhatsApp/email order coordination, and disconnected workshop scheduling, which resulted in significant quoting delays, order bottlenecks during peak hours, and tracking opacity for corporate procurement teams.

solution.title: Our Approach
solution.content:
We re-architected and built an end to end commercial printing portal and operations engine using Domain-Driven Design (Clean Architecture).

### Key Architectural Decisions:
1. **Clean Architecture with NestJS**: Structured the backend into discrete Domain, Use-Case, and Infrastructure layers, ensuring maximum testability and zero framework coupling for core business logic.
2. **Automated B2B Job Ticket Estimator**: Built an intelligent pricing engine that calculates material costs, paper grammage, machine run-times (Heidelberg Speedmaster & Digital Press), finishing techniques (Spot UV, Foil Emas, Hardbox), and wholesale volume discounts instantly.
3. **Asynchronous Processing with BullMQ & Redis**: Offloaded heavy PDF invoice rendering, proofing approvals, and notification dispatches to background worker queues, ensuring responsive sub-100ms API response times.
4. **Corporate Financial Compliance**: Integrated automated tax calculation with official e-Faktur PPN 11% generation and B2B Terms of Payment (TOP) credit facility workflows.
5. **Interactive Procurement Frontend**: Developed a high-performance, accessible frontend with React 19, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS featuring real-time order status tracking and digital RFQ submissions.

impact.title: Business Impact
impact.content: Transformed manual procurement into a seamless self-service and enterprise tracking platform, drastically speeding up quotation turnaround times from hours to seconds and providing 100% realtime tracking visibility across the entire production workshop.

results.title: Key Results
results.content:
- **Instant Quotations** via automated Job Ticket Estimator
- **Zero Downtime** during high volume corporate order spikes
- **Realtime Tracking** for print jobs from Pre-Press to Dispatch
- **Automated Tax Compliance** with official official PPN 11% invoicing
- **Clean Architecture** ensuring high maintainability and test coverage
